transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before I sign off on the annex room assignments and controls, I need facilities and signal to report any room, infrastructure, or opening requirements. Both East and West rooms can be made ready tomorrow morning, and we'll have an equipment-issue desk and a protected medical-records desk to place. What do you need from your end?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Col. Mercer, I need to flag a floor-load concern before we finalize assignments. The equipment-issue desk's steel storage cabinet weighs 1,100 kilograms when stocked. Facilities measured this morning that East Room is rated for 800 kilograms and West Room is rated for 1,500 kilograms. I verified these ratings myself, but the floor-load note hasn't been added to the relocation worksheet yet. Based on this, the equipment-issue desk needs to go in West Room, not East.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Col. Mercer, I need to flag a network infrastructure requirement that affects room assignment. The protected medical-records desk can only connect to the required isolated network through the fiber patch panel located in East Room. My signal technician is already booked to certify that connection from 0900 to 1000 tomorrow morning. I received the booking confirmation this morning, but it hasn't been added to the annex opening checklist yet. This means the protected medical-records desk needs to go in East Room.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Maj. Alvarez to add the floor-load note (East Room 800 kg, West Room 1,500 kg, equipment-issue cabinet 1,100 kg stocked) to the relocation worksheet before opening.
Lt. Okafor to add the signal technician certification booking (0900-1000 tomorrow, fiber patch panel in East Room) to the annex opening checklist before opening.
Both East and West rooms to be made ready tomorrow morning per existing plan.
